raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: csp
  version: "0.19.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name [0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5971d1dfe6290032c79610e0aec76ab5f71669f60a7a3a0e2ac7b4f9ab8b3f0b
  patches:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: patches/0001-remove-autogen.patch
    - patches/0002-local-csp.patch
    - patches/0003-allow-pyarrow-24.patch

build:
  # conda-build fails to find .pyd files co-located next to each other whereas the windows
  # DLL loader does.
  number: 1
  skip: match(python, ">3.14")
  script:
    # We can't cross-compile on csp due to https://github.com/Point72/csp/issues/264
    # So we "fake it" and use pregenerated files
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: mkdir -p $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-{3.10,3.11,3.12,3.13,3.14}/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: mkdir -p $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-{3.10,3.11,3.12,3.13,3.14}/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/engine/{autogen_types.cpp,autogen_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.10/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/engine/{autogen_types.cpp,autogen_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.11/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/engine/{autogen_types.cpp,autogen_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.12/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/engine/{autogen_types.cpp,autogen_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.13/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/engine/{autogen_types.cpp,autogen_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.14/cmake-build/cpp/csp/engine/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/adapters/websocket/{websocket_types.cpp,websocket_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.10/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/adapters/websocket/{websocket_types.cpp,websocket_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.11/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/adapters/websocket/{websocket_types.cpp,websocket_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.12/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/adapters/websocket/{websocket_types.cpp,websocket_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.13/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cp $RECIPE_DIR/patches/adapters/websocket/{websocket_types.cpp,websocket_types.h} $SRC_DIR/_skbuild/macosx-10.15-arm64-3.14/cmake-build/cpp/csp/adapters/websocket/csp_autogen/
    - if: not win
      then: export CSP_USE_VCPKG=0
    - if: not win
      then: $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: win
      then: set CSP_GENERATOR=Visual Studio 17 2022
    - if: win
      then: set CSP_USE_VCPKG=0
    - if: win
      then: "%PYTHON% setup.py build_ext install --single-version-externally-managed  --record=record.txt"
    # Cleanup after, need to tweak pyproject
    - if: not win
      then: rm -rf $PREFIX/cpp $PREFIX/CMakeLists.txt $PREFIX/LICENSE $PREFIX/NOTICE $PREFIX/pyproject.toml $PREFIX/README.md $PREFIX/setup.py $PREFIX/vcpkg.json
  dynamic_linking:
    overlinking_behavior: ${{ "ignore" if win else "error" }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake <4
    - if: not win
      then: make
    - if: not win
      then: bison
    - if: not win
      then: flex
  host:
    - python
    - brotli
    - cmake <4
    - cyrus-sasl
    - deprecated
    - exprtk
    - gtest
    - libarrow
    - libboost-headers
    - libparquet
    - librdkafka
    - lz4-c
    - numpy
    - openssl
    - pip
    - pyarrow
    - pydantic >=2
    - rapidjson
    - ruamel.yaml
    - scikit-build
    - setuptools >=69,<74
    - typing-extensions
    - websocketpp
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    - if: match(python, "<3.9")
      then: backports.zoneinfo
    - deprecated
    - numpy
    - openssl
    - packaging
    - pandas
    - if: match(python, "<3.10")
      then: pandas <2.3
    - pyarrow
    - psutil
    - pydantic >=2
    - pytz
    - rapidjson
    - ruamel.yaml
    - sqlalchemy
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('csp', upper_bound='x.x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - numpy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - csp
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: csp is a high performance reactive stream processing library, written in C++ and Python
  description: csp is a high performance reactive stream processing library, written in C++ and Python
  homepage: http://github.com/point72/csp
  repository: https://github.com/point72/csp

extra:

    - AdamGlustein
